name: wybe-connect
description: Connects Claude Code to your Wybe AI colleague with one sign-in. Sends only the essence: a short list of durable work facts, distilled on your machine by a background claude -p (read-only tools) and redacted before it leaves, plus answers to your colleague's open questions; on «Importer» in your Wybe portal it distils your local history and memory once. Never transcripts. Write-only: nothing is read back from the node.
